title: How many of the single bond type molecules are non-carcinogenic?
question: How many of the single bond type molecules are non-carcinogenic?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.molecule_id)
FROM bond AS T1
INNER JOIN MoleculeLabel AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'
  AND T2.label = '-'
